    Settings & help

    Compare stations

    Choose an area, sign in as Arthur-Freedom, then press Refresh traffic. The highlighted group contains up to five stations, ordered by distance from the area centre or your location. Use the arrows to choose another group. Fresh results rank from less busy to more busy.

    Areas include nearby stations across neighbourhood boundaries. The catalogue combines mapped fuel stations and smaller fuel retailers; coverage is not exhaustive. An unchecked station stays “Not checked”.

    Each refresh measures one approach, up to its final kilometre. Google’s congested-road length drives the bands: less busy below 250 m, busy from 250–899 m, very busy from 900 m. The timestamp shows when Google was queried. Data can lag changing conditions.

    Traffic indicates road congestion, not a confirmed petrol queue or time at the pump. Junctions, through traffic and queues inside the forecourt can differ.

    Opening status & fuel

    Listed closed · unverified comes from a listing, not a visit to the station. Crisis opening hours may differ. These listings never exclude a station or override its traffic ranking.

    A green or red approach does not prove whether the pumps are operating. Opening and fuel availability remain unconfirmed without a recent firsthand report. Only a recent, explicitly sourced firsthand closure can affect the ranking; traffic refreshes never renew opening-report timestamps.

    Refresh limits & owner access

    The server verifies GitHub user ID 18115558 before calling Google. Other accounts and anonymous visitors cannot request paid traffic. The traffic API key stays on the server.

    Up to five stations per refresh and at most ten attempts per Bali day across all devices. Rechecking the same group has a 15-minute cooldown; you can switch to a different group immediately. Five traffic queries cost about US$0.075 after Google’s free allowance. Google map displays have their own allowance. Optional auto-refresh runs only while this tab is visible and pauses when you change area or group.

    A page reload does not make a paid traffic request. Previous results are held only in this page’s memory; failed readings retain their original times.

    Privacy, sources & terms

    Owner sign-in is shared with Bali Cinema Map on this GitHub Pages origin. Sign-out revokes this device session for both apps. Google traffic is held in memory, not saved to GitHub or browser storage. The server stores refresh counts and times.

    Your location is requested only when you press “Show stations near me”. It stays in this page and is used for distances; Google receives fixed station approach coordinates. Directions may include your location when you choose to open them.

    Expanded locations: © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL. The original five locations and their dated opening listings came from Google Maps. Live traffic and its basemap: Google Maps. Public basemap: OpenFreeMap / OpenStreetMap.

    Google Maps use follows Google Maps terms and Google privacy policy. This independent tool does not guarantee opening, fuel availability or waits.
